title: feat(app-shell): inside an app the console bar centers its search between the left group and the utility cluster from lg up (objectui#12472)
body:
Fixes #12472
Clause-②: no

Inside an app, from the `lg` breakpoint up, the console top bar is three zones: the left group (the app pill and its PREVIEW chip), the 「Search ⌘K」 trigger, and the utility cluster (Edit app, the bell, help, the avatar). The trigger sits at the bar's center whatever the two side zones hold. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB` (dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 1, claim comment 6190967595).

## What changes

- **`AppHeader` root, app context only.** When `isApp && hasCommandPalette` (`centersSearch`), the root row draws a middle zone, `hidden lg:flex shrink-0`, holding the desktop trigger, between the left group and the cluster. The left group stays `flex-1 min-w-0`. The cluster adds `lg:flex-1 lg:justify-end lg:min-w-max`. Both side zones therefore grow from the same zero basis, and the middle zone is centered. `lg:min-w-max` means the cluster never shrinks below its own content: when the utilities need more than half the bar, the search yields to the left by the difference instead of overlapping them.
- **The trigger itself is unchanged.** It is the same element, with the same `w-48 xl:w-64`, `aria-label`, `aria-keyshortcuts`, `data-testid="action:command-palette:open"` and `openCommandPalette`. It is now built once as `desktopSearchTrigger` and drawn in the middle zone or, everywhere else, in the cluster's search group as before.
- **The cluster's search group.** With the search centered, it holds only the `lg:hidden` icon button, and the group itself is `lg:hidden`. Three `lg:` rules on the cluster, keyed on a new `data-topbar-search` attribute, stop the Edit app group after it from drawing a divider next to nothing at `lg`. Below `lg` the group, its divider and its spacing are as they were (measured below).
- **A long app name truncates in the pill.** This adds `min-w-0` on the pill's wrapper in `AppHeader` and on `AppSwitcher`'s trigger button. Those were the two flex boxes that held the pill at its full width, so its `truncate` label never engaged.
- **Docs:** one sentence in `packages/app-shell/README.md`'s 「Command palette (⌘K)」 section says where the header draws the trigger. **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell` minor.

No export, prop, option or language-pack key is added, removed or renamed.

### Outside the claim's file surface (declared)

The claim lists `AppHeader.tsx`'s root, left-group wrapper and cluster, plus tests and a changeset. Three edits fall outside it:

1. `AppSwitcher.tsx`: `min-w-0` on the pill's trigger button, plus a two-line comment.
2. The pill's wrapper inside the left group in `AppHeader.tsx`: `min-w-0`.
3. One `README.md` sentence.

Items 1 and 2 are the card's own acceptance ("At 1024 … a long app name truncates in the pill"). The dispatch's mechanism assumption A2 ("the left zone keeps `min-w-0`, so a long app name truncates in the pill") measured false: on `main` the pill never truncates, at any width (label 415 of 415 px in every scenario below). Without these two classes, a long name at 1024 would overlap the centered trigger. Applied under the bounded in-place rule:
- it is this card's acceptance item;
- it is mechanical: `min-w-0` on each flex ancestor of a `truncate` label;
- no open PR names `AppSwitcher`, by a text search with a live control (search reads text, not file lists);
- it adds no new gate family.

The claim's file surface needs the seat's amendment.

## Measured: real layout

**Method.** The real `AppHeader` DOM comes from jsdom: the real `AppSwitcher`, `PresenceAvatars`, `ConnectionStatus`, `PreviewBadge`, `InboxPopover` and sidebar trigger, inside `AppShell`'s header element (`px-2 sm:px-4`). It is laid out in Chromium 141 (Playwright 1.62.1) against the console's own stylesheet, compiled from `apps/console/src/index.css` with its Tailwind v4 toolchain. This is not a running console: the landing seat's HotCRM reading stays the acceptance reading.

The harness reproduces the seat's PR #12469 reading: on the base, `typical` at 1440 puts the trigger's center at x=1122, the number the seat measured. The harness is temporary and not committed. Readings were taken at `de6c17113f`, and match the pre-commit tree cell for cell.

**Scenarios** (all `/apps/crm/…`, palette mounted, admin):
- `typical`: CRM, online, no presence, AI off.
- `longNameOnly`: a 59-character app name.
- `max`: the 59-character name, the offline chip, a `reconnecting` status, 5 presence avatars and AI on.
- `maxDashboard`: `max` plus a 37-character dashboard crumb.
- `system`: `/apps/crm/system/settings`.

**Trigger center minus bar center, in px (base → this PR):**

| scenario | 1440 | 1280 | 1024 |
|---|---|---|---|
| typical | +402 → 0 | +322 → 0 | +226 → 0 |
| longNameOnly | +402 → 0 | +322 → 0 | +226 → 0 |
| max | +368 → 0 | +288 → 0 | +192 → −71.6 |
| maxDashboard | +368 → 0 | +288 → 0 | +192 → −71.6 |
| system | +402 → 0 | +322 → 0 | +226 → 0 |

- **Zones at 1024, typical:** 388 / 216 / 388 px. At 1440: 564 / 280 / 564 px.
- **The utility cluster can exceed its zone at `lg`.** In `max` at 1024 the cluster's content is 459.6 px against an even share of 388 px. The search yields 71.6 px to the left and overlaps nothing. With the `max` cluster, the trigger is exactly centered at 1280 and above.
- **Overlaps** between the zones' visible boxes:
  - base: `max`@1024 3, `max`@768 7, `maxDashboard`@1024 5, `maxDashboard`@768 9, `longNameOnly`@768 1 (the PREVIEW chip over the mobile search icon);
  - this PR: 0 in all 25 scenario × width cells.
- **Pill:** the base never truncates (415 of 415 px). This PR truncates: `max`@1024 155 px, `longNameOnly`@1024 227 px, ellipsized.
- **Below `lg`:**
  - 390 is pixel-identical to the base in all 5 scenarios: every visible element's rect and border, compared;
  - 768 is identical for `typical`;
- **Cluster dividers** (computed): at 1024 and 1440 the Edit app group draws `border-left 0`, `margin-left 4px`, as the search group did after the presence avatars on the base, and the avatar group keeps its divider. At 768 all three groups match the base.

## Scope: app context only (A3)

A palette is mounted by `ConsoleLayout` (variant `app`, every `/apps/APP/…` route, `system/*` included) and by the `/studio` landing (variant `studio`). So "app context only" is not where the search already exists: it needs its own condition. Both shapes share every line of the layout code. The scoped one adds `isApp` to one boolean, so scoping costs no more, and only the scoped shape was built. `system/*` routes center too (seat answer B, `6192102896`).

## Tests

- **New `AppHeader.centeredSearch-12472.test.tsx`, 9 cells.** These cells pin:
  - the trigger is neither in the left group nor in the cluster: the root has three children;
  - the side-zone sizing classes;
  - the trigger's classes and attributes;
  - the `min-w-0` chain from the pill's `truncate` label up to the left zone;
  - the cluster's search group: `lg:hidden`, icon only, and the divider rules.

  CONTROLS:
  - below `lg` the icon button is in the cluster, in its divider group, before Edit app;
  - a `system/*` route centers like an object route, with its crumbs in the left group; `studio` and no-palette keep the two-zone bar.

  That the trigger opens the palette stays `AppHeader.searchTriggerNeedsPalette-11912`'s pin (a real router).
- **Ablation** (objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, under the verify lock, script with a trap restore). There is no `dist` leg: the suite imports `../AppHeader` from source.
  - A1 forces `centersSearch` false, so the trigger is back in the cluster: anchor 1 → 0, blob `57fd910d` → `b90788f4`, **3 failed | 6 passed** (the structure, sizing and search-group cells).
  - A2 drops the pill button's `min-w-0`: anchor 1 → 0, blob `5d0c5c46` → `c7906968`, **1 failed | 8 passed** (the truncation cell).
  - Every restore: blob == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Control on the restored tree: **9 passed**.
- **Union at `de6c17113f`, from the repo root, under the lock:**
  - every suite that names `AppHeader` or `ConsoleLayout`, plus the two `AppSwitcher` suites and the new one: **82 files, 745 passed**, VERDICT command-exit 0;
  - the README- and `.changeset`-reading suites: **43 files, 1477 passed**, VERDICT 0.
- **Type check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` (28 of 28). `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new suite.
- **Gates, exit 0:**
  - `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-presence` ("3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) … 1 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-fixed`;
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)");
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`;
  - eslint `--no-inline-config` on the changed sources: 0 errors. Warnings: `AppHeader.tsx` 17 (base 17), `AppSwitcher.tsx` 3 (base 3), new suite 0.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED.
- **Left to CI:** the `pnpm lint` repo scan, the full `pnpm test`, the performance budget (console build plus eager closure), Build & E2E.

## Acceptance notes

- **`system/*` routes inside an app center the search like any other route** (seat answer B, `6192102896`). In the harness, `/apps/crm/system/settings` reads +402 → 0 at 1440, +322 → 0 at 1280 and +226 → 0 at 1024, with 0 overlaps.
- **Crumb routes share the shrink.** On a dashboard, page or report route, when the left zone is too narrow for the pill and its crumb, both now truncate in proportion to their width; before, the crumb alone gave way, and then the pill spilled over. Measured example: the `system` harness route at 768 (its crumbs read as raw keys, so they are near their 160 px cap) moves 3.6 px from the crumbs to the pill.
- **The tablet band** (`sm` to `lg`) **changes only for names too long to fit**: they truncate instead of overlapping the cluster. A name that fits, and the phone bar, are unchanged.
- The landing seat's 1440 / 1024 / 390 reading on HotCRM is the acceptance reading; this PR's numbers come from the harness above.
